title: 18-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar (Pipe-Style) - Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop leaving towels on the counter—this wall-mounted towel bar keeps them organized, dry, and right where you reach for them in the bathroom.

  • Keep towels within reach: 18-inch straight bar fits hand towels or bath towels at the sink or shower.
  • Get an industrial pipe look: Designed as pipe-style bath accessories within the Pipeline collection for a coordinated, matching pipeline setup.
  • Built for daily use: Iron construction protected with a highly durable powder coat.
  • Clean, decorative finish: Powder-coated surface is designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance.
  • Secure wall installation: Mounts with included mounting plates and color-coordinated hardware.

Specs

  • Collection: Pipeline
  • Material: Iron
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Center-to-center: 18 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in
  • Projection: 3.3 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
